$comment: Curated sound/music library for the whole project - see README.md in this directory. Entries here are DECIDED, not exploratory candidates (those live as throwaway files in tools/tts/sfx-out/, gitignored). Add an entry only after a track has actually been chosen for an episode, via tools/sound-library/add.mjs.

warm-pad-drone.name: Warm Pad Essentials Drone by Mantice
warm-pad-drone.author: bassimat
warm-pad-drone.notes: Won the ElevenLabs-vs-Freesound comparison for S02E01's cold open + Act 1 - EL's generated candidate read as too dramatic for the calm/structural theory-season register. CC0, no attribution required. Full track is 300s; episodes trim what they need.

atmospheric-piano.name: Atmospheric Piano Soundtrack
atmospheric-piano.author: Akkaittou
atmospheric-piano.notes: S02E02 pick. CC-BY - attribution required if published (Akkaittou). Approved by user 2026-08-11 for the extraction acts (1-2), calmer register.

jazzy-ambient-piano.name: Jazzy Ambient Piano (Mansion)
jazzy-ambient-piano.author: Hakren
jazzy-ambient-piano.notes: S02E02 pick. CC0, no attribution needed. Approved by user 2026-08-11.

mystic-minimal-loop.name: Mystic Minimalistic Loop
mystic-minimal-loop.author: The-Sacha-Rush
mystic-minimal-loop.notes: S02E02 pick, slightly more forward-moving than the piano tracks - for Acts 6-7 (mesh/count-up/hub, the episode's busiest beats). CC0, no attribution needed. Approved by user 2026-08-11.

piano-jam-mei.name: Piano Jam Mei 18.m4a
piano-jam-mei.author: Sluri6
piano-jam-mei.notes: HELD, not currently used - too rich/melodic for BPM's dry, understated register per user (2026-08-11): 'too rich to compete with dull BPM material'. Good candidate for a future episode/project that can carry a fuller sound. Do not auto-assign to a BPM episode without re-checking this note.
